Modbus/TCP incident at IED1A, a field device (Modbus server) (b1): 2 anomalous 10-second windows over 1 minute. Per 10-second window, at most: read requests 11-100, write requests 0, requests with other function codes 0, exception responses 0; request rate normal. Observed: requests from a peer never seen in training; requests to register addresses never seen in training; requests for more values than ever seen in training. Deviating counters: frames whose length field does not match their content, or truncated frames (malformed_frames) fell, high deviation; requests for more values than any request seen in training (oversized_qty) rose, high deviation; requests with other function codes (req_other) fell, high deviation; requests that received no response (unanswered) rose, high deviation; requests to register addresses never seen in training (unseen_addr) rose, high deviation.
